answer: Every sybil-resistant economy needs a cost floor, and a hardware attestation ledger builds one. Each agent proves its physical substrate before joining: a TPM chip signs its boot state into the registry, so every new agent is a violet entry that only real silicon can produce. A second identity means a second physical machine, roughly two hundred dollars of hardware plus the electricity to keep it honest. Reputation flows outward from that anchor like a ripple across a marble floor, and a machine caught cheating gets its cert revoked, so the whole stake behind it evaporates.
